A.depoimento: I launched a double strike on the neutral villages of Santarem and Evora, committing my entire army to capture both simultaneously. At my capital, I constructed two spearmen to begin rebuilding my forces. This bold expansion should rapidly increase my territory and resource production.
A.plano: Attacked Santarem and Evora with all troops to capture both neutrals quickly. Built 2 spearmen at Lisboa for next turn's reinforcement. Next turn: assess losses, reinforce captured villages, consider advancing to Coimbra or Faro. Watch for enemy counterattacks.

B.depoimento: I recruited two spearmen and sent my knights to take the neutral towns of Tarragona and Girona, growing my territory.
B.plano: Next turn, reinforce the newly captured villages, train more archers for ranged power, and begin advancing toward Zaragoza to expand further.

A.depoimento: I order a coordinated assault on the neutral villages of Coimbra, Badajoz, and Faro, using their own defenses against them. Our archers, spearmen, and knights strike with cunning. Meanwhile, the capital forges a knight to swell our ranks. On to victory!
A.plano: Attacking Coimbra with 2 archers, Badajoz with 2 spearmen and 1 archer, Faro with 2 knights. Building knight at Lisboa. Garrisons left: Santarem 3 spear + 1 archer, Evora 1 knight, Lisboa 2 spear. Next turn: reinforce captured villages and advance.

A.depoimento: This turn, I focused on reinforcing my newly conquered territories. I sent my elite knight from Lisboa to Coimbra, and a contingent of spearmen and archers from Santarem to both Coimbra and Badajoz. From Evora, I marched a knight to Badajoz to bolster its forces. With these reinforcements, my armies in Coimbra and Badajoz will be strong enough to strike the neutral villages of Porto and Sevilha next turn, expanding my domain and securing the resources I need to win.
A.plano: Reinforce Coimbra with knight from Lisboa and spear/archer from Santarem to prepare attack on Porto. Reinforce Badajoz with spear from Santarem and knight from Evora to prepare attack on Sevilha. Build knight at Lisboa, spear at Santarem, archer at Evora for next turn's growth and defense.

B.depoimento: Built two knights at Barcelona and one archer each at Tarragona and Girona. Sent the lone knight from Tarragona to seize Castellon.
B.plano: Next turn: expect to hold Castellon. Build more knights and archers in Barcelona to prepare assaults on Zaragoza and Huesca. Send reinforcements from Barcelona via Tarragona to Zaragoza and from Girona to Huesca.

A.depoimento: Our armies march on Porto to capture our first neutral village! Our blacksmiths work overtime, forging new weapons, while our soldiers march to reinforce our positions. The King's domain expands!
A.plano: We attacked Porto with a strong force from Coimbra (2 spear, 2 archer, 1 knight) to capture our first neutral village. We reinforced Coimbra with a spear from Santarem, and rotated troops: Lisboa sent a spear to Santarem, Evora sent an archer to Faro, Badajoz sent a spear to Santarem, and Faro sent a knight to Badajoz. We built 2 spears in Lisboa, Coimbra, Badajoz, Faro; 1 knight and 1 spear in Santarem; 1 spear and 1 archer in Evora to grow our army. Next turn, assess the Porto battle, and plan to attack Vigo or Salamanca from Porto, while continuing to build up our forces.

A.depoimento: This turn, we launch a double offensive to secure our borders and expand towards the center. From Porto, our northern army marches on Vigo, leveraging the spearman counter to crush the knight garrison. From Badajoz, a strike force of knights and archers heads east to capture Toledo, opening the road to Madrid. At home, we mobilize our economy, building two spearman in six of our seven villages to swell our ranks for the march on the enemy capital.
A.plano: Attack Vigo from Porto with all troops (2 spear, 2 archer, 1 knight) and Toledo from Badajoz with 2 knights and 1 archer. Build 2 spearman in all 6 active villages to grow our army. Next turn, reinforce the newly captured villages and prepare to march on Madrid.

A.depoimento: This turn, we focused on consolidating our borders and expanding our military might. We constructed fourteen spearmen in our western provinces and marched reinforcements to Coimbra, Badajoz, and Toledo. With our armies strengthened, we stand ready to march into the neutral territories of Salamanca, Sevilha, and Cordoba, taking the first step toward securing the 18 villages needed for victory.
A.plano: Reinforcing the frontlines: Coimbra, Badajoz, and Toledo are receiving troops to prepare for the assault on the neutral villages (Salamanca, Sevilha, Cordoba, Madrid, Teruel, Burgos). We built 14 spearmen across our territory to grow our army. Next turn, we will coordinate attacks on the neutrals with our reinforced armies. Do not attack until we have overwhelming force.

B.depoimento: Sent six spearmen, one archer, and one knight from Barcelona to seize Zaragoza. Built knights in Tarragona, Girona, and Castellon to strengthen our forces for upcoming battles.
B.plano: Capture Zaragoza next turn with a mixed force. Use the newly built knights from Tarragona, Girona, and Castellon to reinforce defenses and prepare for an assault on Teruel. Keep resource production flowing.

A.depoimento: King A mobilizes his forces! Badajoz sends troops to Sevilha and Toledo; Coimbra reinforces Porto. We build spearmen and archers in our villages. Tomorrow we strike at Salamanca and Cordoba!
A.plano: Turn 7 plan: Attack Sevilha with 8 spear from Badajoz (2 turns). Send 3 spear from Badajoz to Toledo to prepare for Cordoba attack. Send 9 spear from Coimbra to Porto to prepare for Salamanca attack. Build archers in Lisboa, Evora, Faro, Toledo; build spearman elsewhere. Next turn: attack Salamanca from Porto (11 spear) and Cordoba from Toledo (5 spear, 2 arch, 1 knight). Also prepare for Burgos by sending from Porto to Vigo.

A.depoimento: This turn, I launched a coordinated assault on Salamanca, sending the entire garrisons of Porto, Coimbra, and Badajoz. The village was captured, and we now hold 11 of 24 villages. I also redistributed forces to strengthen our interior: Badajoz now hosts reinforcements from Santarem and Toledo, Sevilha from Faro, Porto from Vigo, and so on. Our army is growing, and next we turn to Cordoba and Madrid.
A.plano: Salamanca captured. Reinforced Badajoz (Santarem+Toledo), Sevilha (Faro), Porto (Vigo), Santarem (Lisboa), Faro (Evora). Next turn: attack Cordoba from Sevilha (12 troops) and Madrid from Salamanca (11). Also build at all villages, especially Sevilha and Salamanca. Prepare to explore east from Madrid.

A.depoimento: I ordered a strong assault on Salamanca from Porto and on Cordoba from Badajoz, reinforcing both with nearby troops. I built knights across my realm to strengthen my forces. I expect to capture two new villages and expand my territory toward the enemy capital.
A.plano: Attack Salamanca from Porto (15 attack vs 8 defense) and Cordoba from Badajoz (28 attack vs 13 defense). Reinforce Salamanca with Santarem, Coimbra, and Evora; reinforce Sevilha with Faro and Evora. Build knights everywhere except Sevilha (archer). Leave 4 spearman at Badajoz for defense. Next turn: prepare to attack Madrid from Salamanca/Toledo and Teruel from Cordoba; explore east.

B.depoimento: I sent knight detachments to seize Huesca, Valencia, and Teruel while leaving spear and archer garrisons behind, and ordered new spears and knights to replenish my army. No enemy troops were sighted on the roads.
B.plano: Next turn I will check which of Huesca, Valencia, Teruel fell, reinforce those villages with fresh troops, continue building spears for anti‑knight defense, and prepare to take Madrid or Pamplona once I have enough forces.

A.depoimento: This turn, we consolidate our western holdings and launch a decisive offensive. Salamanca and Toledo's combined forces attack Madrid, while Badajoz's legions conquer Cordoba. To the north, we reinforce Vigo to prepare for the assault on Burgos. We are building knights across our empire to ensure our military dominance. The path to Barcelona is opening, and we will bring the enemy king to justice!
A.plano: We are expanding on two fronts: east towards Madrid and north towards Burgos. This turn, Badajoz conquers Cordoba, while Salamanca and Toledo attack Madrid. We reinforce Vigo with Porto's knight to prepare for the assault on Burgos next turn. We also send Sevilha's surplus troops to Cordoba to prepare for the push into Murcia. We build knights in almost every village to maintain our military momentum.

B.depoimento: I sent troops to seize Valencia, Teruel, and Madrid while starting spear production in Zaragoza. I kept defenders at home and avoided overreaching toward Pamplona.
B.plano: Next turn I will check which captures succeeded, reinforce any taken villages, continue building spears for anti‑knight defense, and prepare to take Pamplona once I have enough spearmen.

A.depoimento: Our banners fly over Burgos and Murcia. The knights of the west ride to Toledo, while the archers march to Madrid. The enemy's capital grows weaker as we close in.
A.plano: We are taking Burgos and Murcia. We send all available knights from the west to Toledo to form a strike force. We send Salamanca's troops to Madrid to boost its garrison. We build spearmen in Toledo for Teruel and archers in Salamanca for Madrid. Next turn, we will attack Teruel and Zaragoza. Watch for enemy counterattacks on our borders.

B.depoimento:
This turn I reinforced Zaragoza with new spears and sent spear squads to strengthen Teruel.
I also dispatched the Teruel knight to capture Toledo and ordered spear production at Huesca and Castellon for future offensives.
B.plano:
Next turn I will check if Toledo fell and reinforce any captured village.
Continue building spears at Zaragoza and Huesca for defense, and prepare to take Pamplona once I have enough spearmen.

A.depoimento: Victory is within our grasp! We launch a four-pronged attack this turn to conquer Teruel, Zaragoza, Burgos, and Valencia, bringing our total to 18 villages. The strike force from Toledo hits Teruel, while Madrid takes Zaragoza. Vigo and Murcia sweep up the neutral villages of Burgos and Valencia. Our southern armies march north to reinforce Toledo for the next wave. We build across the realm to replenish our ranks. The enemy capital of Barcelona will soon be in our sights!
A.plano: Conquer Teruel, Zaragoza, Burgos, and Valencia this turn to reach 18 villages. Send Toledo to Teruel, Madrid to Zaragoza, Vigo to Burgos, Murcia to Valencia. Reinforce Toledo with Cordoba and Sevilha marching next turn. Build troops in all villages to rebuild the army. Next turn, push towards Barcelona via Zaragoza and explore the unexplored villages.

B.depoimento:
I built spears at Zaragoza, Huesca, Teruel and Castellon.
I sent three spearmen from Castellon to capture the neutral village of Valencia.
B.plano:
Next turn I will check if Valencia fell and reinforce it.
Continue building spears at Zaragoza and Huesca for defense.
Prepare to take Pamplona once I have enough spearmen.

A.depoimento: Victory! We have secured our 18 villages and are now focusing on defense and reinforcement. Our borders are being fortified with the finest knights and archers from the interior, while our economy continues to produce the resources needed to sustain our campaign. We will hold our ground and prepare for any enemy counter-offensive.
A.plano: We have reached 18 villages. To win, we must hold them for one more turn. We are reinforcing our border villages (Teruel, Zaragoza, Burgos, and staging in Murcia for Valencia) with troops from our interior. We are also building knights in almost all our villages to rebuild our army. We must ensure no enemy attack breaks our borders.

B.depoimento:
I ordered the construction of spears in all my villages to bolster defenses and stockpile for future offensives.
No troops were sent out this turn as I prioritize strengthening my garrisons before attacking.
B.plano:
Next turn I will have increased spear stocks, especially at Castellon and Huesca.
I will then assess whether to launch a focused attack on Teruel or Valencia with a spear-heavy force that counters enemy knights.
I will also continue to build spears and hold my interior villages safe.

A.depoimento: This turn we bolstered our eastern defenses. We rushed archers and knights to Valencia, our weakest border village, and shored up Teruel and Murcia with fresh troops. Our builders worked overtime, producing knights and archers across the realm. We stand ready to repel the enemy's expected assault.
A.plano: Reinforcing Valencia with archers and knights from Murcia and Teruel to defend against Castellon attack. Sending replacements to Teruel (from Toledo) and Murcia (from Cordoba), and a knight from Sevilha to Cordoba. Building knights in most villages, archers in border/relevant ones. Must hold Valencia next turn to secure 18-village win condition. Watch for enemy reinforcements from Tarragona/Barcelona.
